title: Motion Graphics Designer
summary: Motion graphics designers animate app screens, brand stories and explainers, and ship in-app animations as light Lottie files that developers can use. They usually sit in a product design or brand team, working with UI designers, developers and marketers.
dailyDuties: Sketch storyboards and style frames from a brief
Animate brand, product and explainer pieces in After Effects
Build in-app animations and export them as Lottie files
Prepare vector assets from Illustrator and Figma files
Hand over motion specs and check animations with developers
Revise work after product and brand reviews

skills.expectation: Animate product, brand and explainer pieces in After Effects
Make in-app animations and export them as Lottie or Rive files developers can ship
Plan pieces with storyboards and style frames before animating
Prepare layered vector assets in Illustrator for animation
Use typography, colour and layout well in kinetic type and brand motion
Work from Figma product screens and hand over motion specs
Present concepts and take feedback from product, brand and marketing teams
Add simple 3D scenes with Cinema 4D or similar tools
Cut footage together with motion pieces in Premiere Pro
Add sound design and sync music to animation
Prototype interactions in ProtoPie or Figma
Adapt motion pieces for Reels and Shorts
